description: A customer- or merchant-facing web app: the admin template (React 19 + TypeScript strict + Vite, app shell, sign-in, RTL + LTR, Arabic + English, contract-typed data layer, design tokens, local gate, docs and agent rules) in its own folder, named and branded for the web module, with its own task prefix, master branch and backlog. A thin layer: every file comes from templates/admin (the `base`); this template only changes the identity (folder, package name, display names) and adds nothing else yet. Any number of web apps can be generated.

notes.base: templates/admin is read first (files, skip list, binary globs, sentinels, targeted edits, post_generate); the sentinels above replace the admin identity by the web app's own
notes.after_generation: the sample module `items` comes from the admin template; the REST prefix `/admin/v1` of its contract is renamed to this web app's own audience prefix (`__API_PREFIX__`, `/<slug>/v1`), the one the server generates for it: replace the screens and the API of this web app's audience (its backlog and PRD say which)
notes.docs: the admin product documents (Admin_BRD.md, Admin_PRD.md, Admin_Design_Script.md, Admin_Tasks.md) are renamed to the web app's own stem (Parent_Web_BRD.md ...) in paths and in every text that names them, so the documents step writes the web app's BRD, PRD and Design Script there
